name: sim_duel_commands_only_in_a_duel
description: CORK, UNCORK and SEAWALL are Undertow's (contract-m7 §2): in High Water and in Tide Race, in the window and in a wave, each is refused as BAD_COMMAND and changes nothing (no gold, no bottle, no event of the duel's), and neither mode draws a Drift or writes the codec's M7 block.

steps.msg: High Water refuses all three, in the window and in the wave

steps.assert: scene.client(1).bottle_list.is_empty() and scene.client(1).drift_window == 0 and scene.events_of('DRIFT').is_empty() and scene.gold_to(1, 'cork') == 0 and not scene.client(1).duel
scene.refusals(1) == ['BAD_COMMAND'] and scene.refusals(2) == ['BAD_COMMAND'] and not scene.client(1).duel and not scene.client(1).shared_clock
steps.msg: nor does the race take them
